title: Lightly Roasted German Bread Skillet
description: A simple and satisfying solo dinner dish featuring roasted white bread, candy, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, all cooked in a cast-iron skillet. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: candy pieces
ingredients.notes: such as M&M's or chopped peanut butter cups

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the white bread mix into 1-inch cubes and place in a large bowl.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the salt, black pepper, and dried thyme over the bread and toss again.
Add the candy pieces, grated carrot, and chopped fresh parsley to the bowl and toss until everything is well combined.
Heat a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bread mixture to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes, or until the bread is lightly roasted and crispy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
